paragraphs: EZFacility sells online scheduling, management and membership software for gyms, fitness centers, sports facilities and more. Among the business types it names are gyms and health and fitness centers.

Scheduling centralizes physical resources and consolidates classes, clinics and rentals into a color-coded schedule. League and tournament schedules can handle an even or odd number of teams, single byes, or back-to-back double headers. Referee assignments, printable scorecards and photo ID cards for player verification keep games running on time. Staff can be compensated for sessions, classes or clinics completed and for services sold. Payments run through an integrated PCI-compliant product at what the company calls a competitive rate. A branded mobile app gives clients facility information, schedules, trainer profiles and push notifications.

The company says it was created in 2003. It describes itself as one of the largest providers of management software for the sports and fitness industries. It claims thousands of businesses around the world as customers. The software is hosted on Amazon Web Services with a stated 99.99% uptime.
